rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides tools for interacting with Prometheus Alertmanager instances, including alert listing with label matcher filtering and silence lifecycle management. Supports stdio and SSE transport modes with configurable authentication via basic auth, bearer tokens, and custom headers for multi-tenant environments.
